definitions.explanation: The front part of the face below the mouth.
The bone structure that forms the framework of the mouth.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{顎|あご}に{髭|ひげ}を{生|は}やしている。
examples.english: He has a beard on his chin.

examples.japanese: {顎|あご}が{外|はず}れそうなくらい{笑|わら}った。
examples.english: I laughed so hard I thought my jaw would dislocate.

examples.japanese: {顎|あご}を{引|ひ}いて{姿勢|しせい}を{正|ただ}した。
examples.english: I pulled my chin in and corrected my posture.

examples.japanese: {顎|あご}を{手|て}でささえて{考|かんが}えている。
examples.english: She's resting her chin on her hand and thinking.

examples.japanese: {二重|にじゅう}{顎|あご}が{気|き}になる。
examples.english: I'm worried about my double chin.

examples.japanese: {硬|かた}いものを{食|た}べて{顎|あご}が{疲|つか}れた。
examples.english: My jaw got tired from eating something hard.

examples.japanese: {歯医者|はいしゃ}で{顎|あご}を{大|おお}きく{開|あ}けてと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: The dentist told me to open my jaw wide.

examples.japanese: {顎|あご}の{関節|かんせつ}が{痛|いた}くて{口|くち}が{開|あ}けにくい。
examples.english: My jaw joint hurts and it's hard to open my mouth.

examples.japanese: {上|うわ}{顎|あご}と{下|した}{顎|あご}の{噛|か}み{合|あ}わせが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: The bite alignment between my upper and lower jaw is off.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{部下|ぶか}を{顎|あご}で{使|つか}うような{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He's the kind of person who bosses his subordinates around.
examples.notes: {顎|あご}で{使|つか}う is an idiom meaning to order people around arrogantly.

notes:
{顎|あご} refers to both the chin and jaw area.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {顎|あご}を{引|ひ}く (pull chin in, good posture)
- {顎|あご}を{上|あ}げる (raise chin, look up/act proudly)
- {顎|あご}が{外|はず}れる (jaw dislocates; figuratively: laugh hard)
- {顎|あご}{髭|ひげ} (chin beard, goatee)
- {二重|にじゅう}{顎|あご} (double chin)

BODY PART CONTEXT:
Face parts:
- {頬|ほお} (cheek)
- {額|ひたい} (forehead)
- {唇|くちびる} (lips)
- {眉|まゆ} (eyebrow)

IDIOMS:
{顎|あご}で{使|つか}う = to order someone around arrogantly (literally: direct with one's chin)
